svg.aria-label: Rotación de PCA sobre los ejes principales y varianza acumulada explicada
svg.title: Rotación de PCA sobre los ejes principales y varianza acumulada explicada
svg.desc: Seventy correlated two-dimensional points with their mean. The principal axes PC1 and PC2 rotate in from the original axes, the eigenvectors start at the mean with a length proportional to the square root of their eigenvalue, every point is projected onto PC1, and the orange residuals are the variance that is discarded. Here PC1 keeps 94 percent of the variance. On the right, the cumulative explained variance of the 64 pixel features of the digits dataset reaches 90 percent with 21 components and 95 percent with 29.
svg.text: Rotar a los ejes principales y conservar PC1
El 95% de la varianza requiere k = 29
El 90% de la varianza requiere k = 21
